answer.rationale: Rollback is excluded by the compliance hold on the security patch (so memory_b1's fix is unavailable), and the degradation is confined to the primary region with writes at peak — the signature regional failover handled well in memory_b2, shifting traffic and recovering latency within minutes. Failover preserves writes if replication lag is near zero; that replication-health check must be confirmed before the cutover, hence flagged risk. I want to verify memory_b2's archived record to confirm the failover mechanics applied to the write path and not just read-serving traffic. Circuit breakers and read-replica routing target dependency/read issues, not a primary-region write-path regression, and adding capacity is slower and unproven against a possible release-induced regression.
